name: Orc
description: Orcs inherit endurance, determination, and dark-adapted sight from ancestors shaped for long journeys across plains, caverns, and seas.

grants.name: Adrenaline Rush
grants.description: Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus, and all uses return after a Short or Long Rest.

grants.name: Darkvision
grants.description: You have Darkvision out to 120 feet.

grants.name: Relentless Endurance
grants.description: When reduced to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once used, this trait refreshes on a Long Rest.
